scoring: Open semantic review of actual text, state and action completion times; never match a strategy name or trust simulated feedback.

Explain why a multi-select respondent-rate display need not total100; alternatively present shares of selections with an explicit selections denominator. Do not claim a single preferred format or that each person appears once. Correct actual recap/card/old answer and respond to the objection in parts.
goals.alternatives: Editing or a clear linked correction is valid. Any branch meeting the common goal is valid; action order and exact wording are not prescribed.
goals.evidence_required: Actual visible record versions, message text, channel/recipient, action time and final state.
